title: AI Email Follow-up Draft Time Savings
source: Blog Article - How to Start Using AI in Your Small Business (2024)
narration: This chart illustrates the time savings achievable by using AI to draft email follow-ups. The process involves a total of 40 minutes, including draft time, approval, and editing.  AI can reduce the total time by 30 minutes, significantly boosting efficiency. The cost per email is $0.50, making it a cost-effective solution for small businesses.
